rules.rentals: Lowest asking rent $1,800-$2,300; 2+ beds; verified drive of 20 min or less to Mrs. Jerry Bryant Elementary; in-unit washer/dryer + fridge required: homes that fail are removed, homes whose listing does not say are shown and marked; dark kitchen cabinets removed.

notes: Rentals from the scan of Nov 23, 2026, 6:53 AM CT; SUVs from the scan of 2026-11-21 (CT). Nothing is invented: unknown text is "Not listed", unknown numbers are null, photos are the listings' own photo URLs.
